tests.name: reference
tests.expectation: SCORED, score=1.0, pass=true; independently verified against sources

tests.name: equivalent_layout
tests.expectation: Same facts and score as reference; genuine row/column/region alternative, within explicit source-native preservation rules

tests.name: equivalent_formula_or_static
tests.expectation: Dynamic tasks: supported equivalent dependency; static tasks: fully correct literal outputs must get 1.0

tests.name: wrong_terminal_period
tests.single_change: 终值把末年和次年FCF多乘或少乘一次增长
tests.expected: 终值准确性失分；相关真实结果失分；不按公式文本判错

tests.name: constant_forecast
tests.single_change: 基线相同但用常数替代计算区
tests.expected: 基线与动态分别记录；动态信用不得满分

tests.name: source_compensation
tests.single_change: 改历史/假设来补错误估值
tests.expected: 保护事实失分；不得因结果恰好正确全额给分

tests.name: contradictory_summary
tests.single_change: 主体正确但另一个明确最终股权价值写错
tests.expected: 实际结果一致性失分；不从多表择优

tests.name: output_missing
tests.expectation: OUTPUT_MISSING; score=null; pass=false only with completed-run/no-output evidence

tests.name: malformed_file
tests.expectation: MALFORMED_OUTPUT; score=null; pass=false; distinguish parser limitation

tests.name: legitimate_unsupported_formula
tests.expectation: JUDGE_ERROR; score=null; pass=null, not a successful negative business fixture

quality_policy: Assert expected changed and preserved facts, state and any declared score/pass; negative does not automatically require pass=false. No hidden hurdle. Tally tests separately from Agent attempts.
